d: Short, choppy platinum white hair with blunt bangs and a small white frilled maid's cap. The expression is stoic with narrow, glowing cyan eyes behind thin-rimmed glasses, on a face with the maturity of a young adult. The build is slender with mechanical, jointed legs and arms, wearing a white and black maid's dress under a large, oversized burnt-orange cloak, accessorized with a black choker and a white ribbon bow. Two long, pointed black animal ears emerge from the top of the head. BODY COLOR: pale pinkish-white LEGS: plantigrade, robotic feet with a split-toe design.
